children: ACNB declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.46 per share and a special dividend of $0.75 per share.
The regular dividend increased 9.5% from $0.42 per share paid in the prior quarter.
Shareholders will receive combined cash dividends of $1.21 per share on December 15, 2026.
Both dividends are payable to shareholders of record as of December 1, 2026.
Declared dividends bring ACNB's 2026 total to $2.93 per share, approximately 112% above the $1.38 paid in 2025.
